## Summary
What does this change do, and which approved roadmap objective/spec does it serve?

## Scope
- [ ] Change is limited to the approved slice.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor or cleanup is included.
- [ ] Relevant spec/plan is linked or this is explicitly a small low-risk change.

## Verification
- [ ] Lint/build/relevant automated checks run.
- [ ] Targeted regression testing completed.
- [ ] Manual checks are listed where automation is absent.
- [ ] Preview verified where applicable.
- [ ] Responsive/accessibility regression checked for UI changes.

## Security and data
- [ ] Auth/authz impact reviewed.
- [ ] RLS/service-role/data-access impact reviewed.
- [ ] Payment/refund/webhook impact reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Customer data and external-transfer impact reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive diagnostic data added.

## Database / configuration
- [ ] Migration implications identified.
- [ ] Environment/configuration changes identified.
- [ ] Production-data effects identified.
- [ ] Destructive or consequential operations have explicit human approval.
- [ ] Rollback/recovery plan is documented where required.

## Independent review
- [ ] Implementer is not the sole reviewer.
- [ ] Security review completed where required.
- [ ] Known limitations/risks are documented.

## Release
- [ ] Full diff reviewed.
- [ ] Human acceptance obtained.
- [ ] Production implications re-checked immediately before release.
- [ ] Relevant roadmap/change-log/spec/security docs updated.
